note: Build 12 plus four pieces, each reviewed by someone who did not build it, joined and verified together (R578-R614). FR-755: a 'Move library' that stopped at its last steps is finished when the library is opened at its new place, after every file there is checked again against the move's own record; the old copy of an unfinished move opens read-only and names the new place; an old copy is not deletable while its move is unfinished or its new place cannot be read. FR-750 and the first piece of FR-756: a screen whose first reads get no answer from the app's own service no longer waits for ever - after twenty seconds it says 'The library service did not answer in time.' with 'Try again' (Find and acquire, Watched folders, Zotero sync, the opening screen and its chooser, the library screen), and an event stream that does not open in time is opened afresh. Decision 31 (c), 'Look up again': review entries whose lookup was left out because a service said 'too many requests' are looked up again, by an automatic pass while the library is open and by a button; answers come as suggested matches and nothing changes until one is accepted; a service that asked to wait is held also across a close and a reopening. The test harness's wait for a quiet page is mended (R614).
